name: io.github.pironjulien/nexus-android
title: NexusAndroid
description: Android computer use over plain ADB: screen, gestures, SMS, notifications, files. No root, no app.

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_ANDROID_ADB
environmentVariables.description: Full path to adb when it is not on the PATH

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_ANDROID_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Force a device by serial number or ip:port

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_ANDROID_KEEP_AWAKE
environmentVariables.description: 0 turns off the keep-screen-on session while the agent works

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_ANDROID_AWAKE_IDLE
environmentVariables.description: Seconds without any gesture before the original screen timeout is restored and the screen turned off

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_ANDROID_ADB_DOWNLOAD
environmentVariables.description: 0 never downloads Google's Platform Tools when adb is missing or the server's own copy is outdated

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_ANDROID_UPDATE
environmentVariables.description: 0 turns off the daily update check (PyPI, Platform Tools manifest)
